name: Landing Page Development
title: Landing Page Design & Development | WebsBy Abhi
desc: Landing page design and development built around one goal: enquiries, bookings or sign-ups. Fast, mobile-friendly and focused.
h1: Landing pages built around one clear goal
what: A single focused page that explains one offer and asks visitors to take one action.
who: Businesses running an offer, launching a service, or sending Instagram or ad traffic somewhere that should convert.
problem: Sending people to a busy homepage or a profile link means many leave without acting.
includes: One clear message and one clear call to action
Enquiry form or direct contact buttons
benefit: Less confusion for visitors and a clearer path from interest to enquiry.
faqs: What is a landing page for?
To present one offer and ask visitors for one action, such as sending an enquiry.
Do I need a full website as well?
Not necessarily. A landing page works on its own for one offer or campaign and can grow into a full website later.
How long does a landing page take?
It is usually quicker than a full website because it is a single page. You get a timeline before work begins.
